title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Citi maintains sell on Hindustan Zinc; Morgan Stanley remains overweight on Dixon
text: Brokerages shared their views on metals and electronics. Citi maintains sell on Hindustan Zinc with a target price of Rs 420, citing weaker zinc prices. Morgan Stanley remains overweight on Dixon with a target of Rs 18,500 as order inflows stay strong.

title: Tata Technologies: PL Capital Retains 'Reduce', Sees Limited Upside From Current Levels; Check Target Price
text: PL Capital retained its reduce rating on Tata Technologies after the investor day, with a target price of Rs 670. The brokerage believes the growth roadmap is already priced in.
